'''Symbiosis''' was a process involving multiple life forms. According to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] were '''symbionts''', whereas [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] thought of them interlopers.<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> [[Symbiote]]s bred by the [[Swonk]]s also lived on [[Khaërn VII]]<ref name="Peurs">{{CasusBelliCite|99|La somme de toutes les peurs}}</ref> A mystical and symbiotic bond existed between the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] and the [[Bantha/Legends|Banthas]] that lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Wildlife">''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]''</ref>
